description: UQ provides Copilot Chat through Microsoft 365 for staff and students. This is IT access only; separate paid Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing and assessment permission remain distinct.
howToObtain: Use UQ Microsoft 365 account; age and Academic Title Holder limits in an older staff page remain unverified.
costToUser: No additional cost for Copilot Chat per current UQ materials; paid Microsoft 365 Copilot is distinct.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: As UQ's enterprise system, Copilot Chat provides a higher level of data security and privacy than other AI tools.
available to all UQ staff and students for no additional cost

For Microsoft 365 Copilot:


	
UQ staff may have access through UQ organisational units.
	
Students may have access through personal accounts but it is not available via UQ.
UQ organisational units can purchase and manage Microsoft 365 Copilot licences for their staff. These add-on licences have a cost per staff member.
able to access information in manually uploaded files
